acceptance.when: the user creates a task with a title, optional description, priority and due date
acceptance.then: the task is stored with status Todo, not archived, and with its creation and update times set

acceptance.when: the user submits an empty title or a title longer than 200 characters
acceptance.then: the task is rejected with a message naming the title field (BR-1)

acceptance.when: the user submits a description longer than 2,000 characters
acceptance.then: the task is rejected with a message naming the description field (BR-2)

acceptance.when: a status other than Todo / In Progress / Done or a priority other than Low / Medium / High is submitted
acceptance.then: the change is rejected (BR-3)

acceptance.when: the user edits its title, description, status, priority or due date
acceptance.then: the changes are saved and its update time changes

acceptance.when: the user marks it completed
acceptance.then: its status is Done (BR-5)

acceptance.when: the user archives it
acceptance.then: it no longer appears in the default task list but can still be listed by asking for archived tasks, and restoring it brings it back to the default list (BR-4)

acceptance.when: the user deletes it
acceptance.then: it is never returned by any normal list, search, lookup or summary again (BR-14)

acceptance.when: the user searches by text
acceptance.then: only tasks whose title contains that text (ignoring case) are listed

acceptance.when: the user filters by status, priority and/or due date and chooses a sort (due date or creation date)
acceptance.then: only matching tasks are listed, in that order

acceptance.given: a task with a due date before today that is not Done and not archived
acceptance.when: the user asks for overdue tasks
acceptance.then: that task is listed as overdue; a task due today, a Done task or an archived task is not

acceptance.when: the Tasks page shows the list
acceptance.then: an empty state guides the user to the Add Task action

acceptance.when: the user creates a habit with a name, optional description and frequency Daily or Weekly
acceptance.then: it is stored as active with its creation time set

acceptance.when: the user submits an empty name or a name longer than 150 characters
acceptance.then: the habit is rejected with a message naming the name field (BR-6)

acceptance.when: the user marks it complete for today
acceptance.then: one completion record for that habit and today's date is stored

acceptance.given: a habit already completed for a date
acceptance.when: the user tries to complete it again for the same date
acceptance.then: no second record is created and the user is told it is already complete for that date (BR-7)

acceptance.when: the user views it
acceptance.then: its frequency label, whether it is complete for the current period and its current streak are shown

acceptance.when: the user edits its name, description or frequency
acceptance.then: the changes are saved

acceptance.when: the user deactivates it
acceptance.then: it is no longer listed among active habits or today's habits, keeps its history, and cannot be completed until it is active again

acceptance.when: the user removes it
acceptance.then: the habit and its completions are never returned by normal queries again (BR-14)

acceptance.when: the Habits page shows the list
acceptance.then: an empty state guides the user to the Add Habit action

stories.title: Track learning resources with milestones and notes

acceptance.when: the user adds a card with a title and optional description/source
acceptance.then: it is stored with status Not Started and its creation time set

acceptance.when: the user submits an empty title
acceptance.then: the card is rejected with a message naming the title field (BR-8)

acceptance.when: the user changes its status to Not Started, In Progress or Completed
acceptance.then: the new status is saved; any other value is rejected

acceptance.when: the user adds a milestone with a title and an optional target date
acceptance.then: the milestone is stored under that card only, not done (BR-9)

acceptance.when: the user marks it done (or not done again), or removes it
acceptance.then: its done flag is saved; a removed milestone is no longer returned

acceptance.when: the user adds a note with text, or removes a note
acceptance.then: the note is stored under that card with its timestamp; a removed note is no longer returned

acceptance.given: a card with milestones and notes
acceptance.when: the user removes the card
acceptance.then: the card, its milestones and its notes are never returned by normal queries again (BR-14)

acceptance.when: the user expands it
acceptance.then: its milestones and notes are shown

acceptance.when: the page shows the grid
acceptance.then: an empty state guides the user to the Add Learning Card action

acceptance.given: existing tasks, habits and learning cards
acceptance.when: the user creates a plan selecting one or more of them with a title, estimated duration, start date-time, end date-time and priority order
acceptance.then: the plan is stored with one item per selected entity (each not done) and its creation time set

acceptance.when: the user selects no items, or an item that does not exist (or was deleted)
acceptance.then: the plan is rejected (BR-10)

acceptance.when: the end date-time is equal to or before the start date-time
acceptance.then: the plan is rejected with a message naming the end date-time (BR-11)

acceptance.when: the user marks an item done or not done
acceptance.then: the item's done flag is saved and the plan's progress percentage becomes (items done) / (total items), shown immediately on the plan and on the Dashboard (FR-08)

acceptance.given: a plan item that references a task, habit or learning card
acceptance.when: the user marks it done
acceptance.then: the original entity's completion state changes only as stated in FR-07.5 (BR-13)

acceptance.given: a plan whose start date-time is in the future
acceptance.when: the plan is read
acceptance.then: its status is Not Started and no rest time is shown (BR-12)

acceptance.given: a plan whose start date-time has passed and whose end date-time has not
acceptance.when: the plan is read
acceptance.then: its status is In Progress (unless all its items are done, which makes it Completed per FR-08.4) and its rest time is the time left until its end date-time, updating continuously

acceptance.given: a plan whose status follows FR-08.4
acceptance.when: the app is closed and reopened
acceptance.then: the same status is shown, computed from the stored times, the item flags and the current time (NFR-4)

acceptance.given: the Todo Plans page is open
acceptance.when: a plan's start date-time is reached
acceptance.then: the user sees an in-app notification/highlight for that plan

acceptance.when: the user opens the Todo Plans page
acceptance.then: plans are grouped into active/upcoming and completed, each showing its progress, rest time (when active), items with done toggles and a remove action; active/upcoming plans are ordered by priority order

acceptance.when: the user views the history
acceptance.then: each shows how much of it was completed (percentage of items done)

acceptance.when: the user removes it
acceptance.then: the plan and its items are never returned again, and the tasks, habits and learning cards it referenced are unchanged (BR-14)

acceptance.when: the page shows the list
acceptance.then: an empty state guides the user to the Create Plan action

acceptance.given: tasks due today, overdue tasks and tasks completed today
acceptance.when: the user opens the Dashboard
acceptance.then: each group lists exactly those tasks (non-archived only)

acceptance.when: the user opens the Dashboard
acceptance.then: today's habits list the active habits and marks those completed today, with counts matching the data

acceptance.when: the Dashboard shows the task completion percentage
acceptance.then: it equals (non-archived tasks with status Done) / (all non-archived tasks), and 0% when there are none

acceptance.when: the user opens the Dashboard
acceptance.then: each is shown with its progress percentage and live rest time; ticking an item in a plan changes the Dashboard figures on the next view without other action

acceptance.when: the user opens the Dashboard
acceptance.then: the learning snapshot shows the number of cards per status and milestones done out of total, matching the data

acceptance.when: the user uses a quick-add action (task, habit, learning card, plan)
acceptance.then: the matching add form opens

acceptance.when: the user uses the persistent navigation
acceptance.then: Dashboard, Tasks, Habits, Learning Resources, Todo Plans and Settings are each reachable

acceptance.when: the user opens it
acceptance.then: the profile information and current preferences are shown

acceptance.when: the user changes a preference and saves
acceptance.then: it is kept between sessions and takes effect (FR-10)

requirements.text: A task holds an id, title, description, status (Todo, In Progress, Done), priority (Low, Medium, High), due date (optional calendar date), creation time, update time and an archived flag.
The user can create, read, update, archive, restore and delete tasks.
New tasks default to status Todo, priority Medium (when none is given) and not archived.
Marking a task completed sets status Done and records the completion time; setting it back to Todo or In Progress clears it (BR-5).
Title required, at most 200 characters (BR-1); description optional, at most 2,000 (BR-2); status and priority from the listed values (BR-3).
Archived tasks are excluded from the default list and returned only when archived tasks are asked for (BR-4).
A task is overdue when its due date is before today (app time zone), status not Done and not archived; the user can list overdue tasks.
Free-text search on the title (case-insensitive substring).
Filter by status, priority, due date (inclusive from/to range, either end optional) and archived (default not archived), combinable.
Sort by due date or creation date, ascending or descending (default creation date, newest first).
A habit holds an id, name, description (optional, at most 2,000 characters), frequency (Daily, Weekly), creation time and an active flag.
The user can create, read, update, deactivate, reactivate and delete habits; new habits are active.
Habit name required, at most 150 characters (BR-6); frequency Daily or Weekly.
A completion event (id, habit id, completion date, creation time) is recorded when the user marks a habit complete for a date (default today, app time zone; future dates rejected).
A second completion for the same habit and date is prevented and reported (BR-7).
The user can undo a habit's completion for a date.
Only active habits can be completed.
Per habit: done for the current period (today / current Monday-Sunday week) and current streak of consecutive periods with a completion.
A learning card holds an id, title, description/source (optional, at most 2,000 characters), creation time and status (Not Started, In Progress, Completed; default Not Started).
The user can add, read, update (title, description, status) and remove cards; title required (BR-8), at most 200 characters.
Milestones: title (required, at most 200), done flag, optional target date, belonging to exactly one card (BR-9).
Notes: text (required) and creation timestamp.
Add, complete/un-complete and remove milestones; add and remove notes under a card; removing a card removes its milestones and notes.
A plan holds an id, title (required, at most 200), plan items, estimated duration (positive minutes), start and end date-time, priority order (positive integer, 1 highest), status and creation time.
Each plan item references one existing task, habit or learning card by type and id, carries its own done flag (default false); an entity appears at most once per plan.
Create a plan from one or more existing non-deleted items (BR-10), set and edit its fields, mark items done/not done, remove the plan.
End date-time after start date-time (BR-11).

Marking an item done changes the source only where it is the source's own completion: a task-type item done sets the task Done with completedAt (BR-13). Only TASK items propagate, one way: un-ticking never changes the source; HABIT and LEARNING_RESOURCE items never change their source (Q1).
Deleting a source keeps the plan item (marked as referring to a removed item), still counted in progress; the deleted entity is never returned (BR-14).
In-app notification when a plan's start date-time is reached.
Rest time (end minus now) shown and updated continuously only between start and end (BR-12).
Completion percentage = items done / total items, whole percent.

Status computed on read from start/end, item flags and now: NOT_STARTED while now < start; COMPLETED once now >= end, or now >= start and all items done; otherwise IN_PROGRESS (un-ticking before the end moves it back to IN_PROGRESS) (Q2).
Item completion changes reflected immediately in the plan's progress and the Dashboard.

Dashboard shows greeting, metric cards, tasks due today, overdue tasks, tasks completed today, active habits and those done today, task completion %, in-progress plans with rest time and progress, learning snapshot (cards per status, milestones done/total), quick-add actions.
Dashboard figures computed from current data on read.
Persistent navigation to Dashboard, Tasks, Habits, Learning Resources, Todo Plans, Settings.

Settings shows profile information and preferences and keeps changes between sessions: displayName (optional, <= 100 chars, used in the Dashboard greeting via GET /api/settings), planStartNotifications (on/off, default on; the frontend shows plan-start notifications only when on), defaultPage (one of the six pages, default DASHBOARD); stored on the server; time zone shown read-only from GET /api/app-info (Q3).
Create/update/delete/filter actions under 500 ms.
Rest-time indicators update at least once per minute while a plan is in progress.
State persists between sessions.
Plan status transitions computed consistently from stored times and item completion, also after reopening.
List pages support add/remove on the page; empty states point to the add action.

rules.text: Task title is required and at most 200 characters.
Task description is optional and at most 2,000 characters.
A task cannot have an invalid status or priority.
An archived task is excluded from the default task list.
A completed task has status Done.
A habit name is required and at most 150 characters.
A habit can have only one completion record for a specific date.
A learning card title is required.
A milestone belongs to exactly one learning card.
A plan must reference at least one existing task, habit or learning-resource item.
A plan's end date-time must be after its start date-time.
A plan's rest-time display is only active between its start date-time and end date-time.

Marking a plan item done does not alter the original entity's completion state outside the plan, except where the item directly represents that entity's own completion action (completing a task-type item completes the task).
Deleted resources cannot be returned by normal queries.
